GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 400 (12 Oct 45) PH
(SCAPIN - 129)
12 October 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Supply of Biologicals.
1．The Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers directs that the Imperial Japanese Government will within 15 days report the following:
a. Current stocks of the following biological products in the hands of producers, wholesalers, central control company and the Army and Navy.
Unit of Measure
1. Cholera Vaccine Human cc
2. Diphtheria Antitoxin Human Unit
3. Diphtheria Toxiod Human cc
4. Plague Vaccine Human cc
5. Smallpox Vaccine Human Individual
vaccination
6. Anti-Rabies Vaccine Human cc
7. Vaccine, Triple typhoid, Prophylactic Human cc
8. Syringe 10cc each
9. Needle for Syringe 23 guage 3/4" Dozen
10. Anthrax Vaccine Veterinary cc
11. Mallein Lutraderinic Veterinary Dose
12. Tuberculin Lutraderinic Veterinary Dose
13. Blackleg Vaccine Veterinary Dose
14. Anti-Hog Cholera Serum Veterinary cc
15. Rabies Vaccine, Canine Veterinary cc
b. Estimated quantities of above items which can be manufactured in the next six months with available facilities and material.
2. The quantities will be shown in the units of measure as listed above for each item.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
DISTRIBUTION:
WARCOS (3) Govt Sec
Sixth Army Civil I & E
Eighth Army ESS
C/S BFOR, BPF
G-4 Political Adv (3)
